name: @mun/ui
description: Native-first Mün UI language, compiler, runtime, and compatibility adapters.

scripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build:workspace && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test:runtime: node --test tests/react-runtime.test.mjs tests/react-widgets.test.mjs tests/react-client.test.mjs tests/macro-react.test.mjs tests/new-features.test.mjs tests/view-system.test.mjs
scripts.test:animation: pnpm --filter @mun/animation run test:full && pnpm --filter @mun/animation run typecheck
scripts.test:packages: node --test --test-concurrency=4 tests/core.test.mjs tests/animation-manifest.test.mjs tests/content-transition.test.mjs tests/graph-modules.test.mjs tests/compiler-modules.test.mjs tests/web-modules.test.mjs tests/bundle-size.test.mjs tests/react-package.test.mjs tests/web-package.test.mjs tests/astro-package.test.mjs tests/vue-package.test.mjs tests/vue-live.test.mjs tests/compiler-package.test.mjs tests/compiler-hardening.test.mjs tests/native-production-contract.test.mjs tests/compiler-parser-fuzz.test.mjs tests/canonical-exports.test.mjs tests/api-surface.test.mjs tests/button-initializers.test.mjs tests/layout-primitives.test.mjs tests/renderer-conformance.test.mjs tests/renderer-conformance-live.test.mjs tests/control-primitives.test.mjs tests/collection-interop.test.mjs tests/presentation-primitives.test.mjs tests/advanced-primitives.test.mjs tests/vscode-extension.test.mjs tests/editor-integrations.test.mjs tests/mun-cli.test.mjs tests/workspace-packaging.test.mjs tests/npm-release-script.test.mjs tests/vue-host-codegen.test.mjs tests/devtools.test.mjs tests/web-primitives.test.mjs tests/motion-planner.test.mjs tests/resident-execution.test.mjs tests/packed-state.test.mjs tests/resident-fusion.test.mjs tests/resident-planner.test.mjs tests/resident-native.test.mjs tests/patch-ir.test.mjs tests/gpu-island-ir.test.mjs tests/gpu-island-renderer.test.mjs tests/gpu-region.test.mjs tests/gpu-island.test.mjs tests/execution-substrate.test.mjs
scripts.benchmark:modifiers:ci: MUN_BENCH_CI=1 MUN_BENCH_BASE_RATIO=8 MUN_BENCH_DEPTH_RATIO=4 pnpm run benchmark:modifiers
scripts.benchmark:performance:ci: MUN_BENCH_CI=1 pnpm run build:workspace && MUN_BENCH_CI=1 node --expose-gc benchmarks/performance.mjs
scripts.benchmark:resident: pnpm --filter @mun/core run build && pnpm --filter @mun/compiler run build && node benchmarks/resident-compute.mjs
scripts.benchmark:resident:native: pnpm --filter @mun/core run build && pnpm --filter @mun/compiler run build && pnpm --filter @mun/execution run build && node benchmarks/resident-native.mjs
scripts.benchmark:browser: pnpm run build:workspace && vite build --config benchmarks/browser.vite.config.ts && node benchmarks/browser-performance.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm run test:types && pnpm run test:animation && pnpm run test:runtime && pnpm run test:packages && pnpm run test:docs && pnpm run test:release
scripts.demo:parity:build: pnpm run demo:parity:react:build && pnpm run demo:parity:vue:build && pnpm run demo:parity:web:build
scripts.demo:all:build: pnpm run demo:build && pnpm run demo:vue:build && pnpm run demo:web:build && pnpm run demo:parity:build && pnpm run demo:showcase:build
scripts.demo:release:build: pnpm run demo:build && pnpm run demo:web:build
scripts.release:check: pnpm test && pnpm run demo:release:build && pnpm run test:browser:built:smoke
scripts.release:check:full: pnpm test && pnpm run benchmark:performance:ci && pnpm run benchmark:resident:native:ci && pnpm run benchmark:browser:ci && pnpm run demo:all:build && pnpm run test:browser:built
